blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remain prone to visual hallucinations when correct responses depend on subtle visual details. One line of post-training methods constructs visual contrasts through image retrieval, generation, or editing to improve fine-grained perception. However, these contrasts are not built around the model's own hallucinations, making it difficult to ensure that supervision targets its actual perceptual confusions. Another line suppresses hallucinated outputs through response correction or preference learning under fixed image conditions, but leaves the design of supervision signals on the image-input side underexplored. Inspired by how humans correct misconceptions, we introduce DreamRealm, a post-training framework that explores diverse latent hallucinated responses, minimally edits original images to make them valid, and trains the model to assign each response to its supporting image. Our data construction pipeline, RealmForgePipe, mines observed and latent hallucinations from a target model and materializes them through image editing. Using hallucinations mined from Qwen3.5-9B, we construct the Realized Hallucination Dataset (RealmSet). Our training objective, RealmMatch, constructs a likelihood score matrix across image--response combinations and combines supervised learning with bidirectional contrastive losses to reinforce correct matches and suppress mismatches. Compared with the original Qwen3.5-9B model, DreamRealm improves performance across six visual perception and hallucination benchmarks, including gains of 7.26 percentage points in HallusionBench accuracy and 11.34 percentage points in MMVP pair accuracy. Together with ablation studies on data construction and training methods, these results demonstrate that hallucination assignment is a promising paradigm for improving visual perception and mitigating hallucinations.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)仍然容易出现视觉幻觉,因为正确的反应取决于微妙的视觉细节. 一行的训练后方法通过图像检索,生成,或编辑构建视觉对比,以改善精细的感知. 然而,这些对比并不是围绕模型本身的幻觉构建的,因此很难确保监督针对其实际的知觉混淆. 另一行通过响应校正或者在固定图像条件下的偏好学习来抑制幻觉输出,但将监督信号的设计留在图像输入方上未得到充分探索. 受人类如何纠正误解的启发,我们引入了DreamRealm,一个后训练框架,探索各种潜在的幻觉反应,尽量减少原始图像的编辑,使其有效,并训练模型将每个反应分配到其辅助图像. 我们的数据建设管道RealmForgePipe、地雷和从目标模型中观察到的潜在幻觉通过图像编辑实现。 利用从Quen3.5-9B中挖掘出来的幻觉,我们构建了已实现的幻觉数据集(RealmSet)。 我们的训练目标RealmMatch构建了一个跨图像-应答组合的概率分数矩阵,并将有监督的学习与双向对比性损失结合起来,强化对匹配的正确性和抑制不匹配. 与最初的Quen3.5-9B模型相比,DreamRealm在6个视觉感知和幻觉基准上提高了性能,包括Hallusion Bench精度的7.26个百分点和MMVP对精度的11.34个百分点. 这些结果连同关于数据构建和培训方法的研究表明,幻觉分配是改善视觉感知和减轻幻觉的有希望的范例。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Motivation of DreamRealm. Existing post-training methods correct hallucinated responses, while supervision on the visual conditions that would make them valid remains underexplored. Inspired by how humans correct misconceptions, DreamRealm materializes these conditions and teaches the model to match hallucinated responses to their supporting images.
blocks.zh: 图1:梦幻的动机. 现有的训练后方法纠正了幻觉反应,而对于使这些反应生效的视觉条件的监督仍然不够充分。 受人类如何纠正误解的启发,DreamRealm实现了这些条件,并教模型将幻觉反应与其支持的图像相匹配.

blocks.en: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in visual understanding [ 1 , 36 ] . However, these models still generate content that contradicts image facts or lacks support from visual evidence, a phenomenon known as visual hallucination [ 14 , 10 , 35 ] . This problem is particularly pronounced when correct responses depend on subtle visual differences [ 33 , 10 ] . Such discrepancies between model outputs and visual evidence remain a major obstacle to the reliable application of multimodal models.
blocks.zh: 近期的多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在视觉理解[1,36]方面表现出了强大的能力. 然而,这些模型仍然产生与图像事实相矛盾或缺乏视觉证据支持的内容,这种现象被称为视觉幻觉[14,10,35]. 当正确的反应取决于细微的视觉差异[33,10]时,这个问题就特别突出. 模型产出与视觉证据之间的这种差异仍然是可靠应用多式联运模型的主要障碍。

blocks.en: A line of post-training work mitigates visual hallucinations through response correction, contrastive supervision, and preference learning [ 41 , 42 , 27 ] . These methods treat the image as a fixed condition and teach models to reject or revise hallucinated responses. Another line of work constructs visual contrasts through image generation or retrieval, helping models understand the relationship between fine-grained visual changes and different responses [ 16 , 8 , 2 ] . However, these visual contrasts are not constructed specifically around the target model’s hallucinations, making it difficult to ensure that supervision focuses on its actual perceptual confusions.
blocks.zh: 一系列培训后工作通过反应矫正,对比性监督,以及偏好学习等,缓解视觉幻觉[41,42,27]. 这些方法将图像视为固定条件,并教模型拒绝或修改幻觉反应. 另一行工作通过图像生成或检索构建视觉对比,帮助模型理解细纹视觉变化和不同反应之间的关系[16,8,2]. 然而,这些视觉对比并不是专门围绕目标模型的幻觉构建的,因此很难确保监督侧重于其实际的知觉混淆.

blocks.en: How humans correct misconceptions offers an intuitive starting point for designing supervision around specific perceptual confusions. When a child mistakes medicine tablets for foods such as candy or cookies, a parent may explain, “This is medicine, not a snack,” and also teach the child what real candy, cookies, and other foods are. However, this form of supervision remains underexplored in existing post-training approaches, as illustrated in Figure 1 . Inspired by this process, we explore a model’s diverse latent hallucinated responses, construct visual conditions that support each response, and train the model to match these responses to their supporting visual conditions.
blocks.zh: 人类如何纠正误解,为设计围绕具体概念混淆的监督提供了一个直观的出发点。 当儿童误读糖果或饼干等食品的药片时,家长可以解释“这是药品,不是小吃”,并教儿童真正的糖果、饼干和其他食品是什么。 然而,如图1所示,这种形式的监督在现有的培训后办法中仍然没有得到充分利用。 在这一过程的启发下,我们探索了一个模型的各种潜在幻觉反应,构建支持每个反应的视觉条件,并训练模型将这些反应与支持性的视觉条件相匹配.

blocks.en: To this end, we introduce DreamRealm , a post-training framework centered on matching hallucinated responses to their supporting images . We first expose different error patterns through repeated high-temperature sampling from the target model, then expand the set of latent hallucinated responses by exploiting the enumerable key attributes of multimodal perception questions. We select hallucinated responses that the model is more inclined to produce based on their likelihood scores. An image-editing pipeline then minimally edits the original images to make the selected responses valid, materializing the model’s hallucination world. We cross-pair the original and materialized images with the candidate responses to construct a likelihood score matrix. Through bidirectional contrastive losses, the model learns to suppress mismatched responses while assigning each hallucinated response to its corresponding supporting image. DreamRealm improves performance across six visual perception and hallucination benchmarks on Qwen3.5-9B [ 23 ] , including gains of 7.26 percentage points in HallusionBench accuracy and 11.34 percentage points in MMVP pair accuracy. We further conduct ablation studies on data construction and training methods to systematically analyze the roles of hallucination-guided image editing, latent hallucination mining, and bidirectional correspondence learning.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们介绍了DreamRealm,这是一个培训后框架,其核心是将幻觉反应与他们的支持图像相匹配。 我们首先通过从目标模型中反复进行高温采样,暴露出不同的错误模式,然后通过利用多式联运感知问题的可假定关键属性,扩大潜在幻觉反应的组合. 我们选择了幻觉反应,模型更倾向于根据其概率分数产生. 一个图像编辑管道然后最小化地编辑原始图像,以使所选的响应有效,实现模型的幻觉世界. 我们将原始的和已实现的图像与候选人的答复相交叉,以构建一个概率计分矩阵。 通过双向对比损失,模型学习抑制不匹配的响应,同时将每个幻觉反应分配给相应的支持图像. DreamRealm在Quen3.5-9B[23]上改进了6个视觉感知和幻觉基准的性能,包括Hallusion Bench精度提高7.26个百分点,MMVP对精度提高11.34个百分点. 我们进一步开展数据构建和培训方法研究,系统地分析幻觉导引图像编辑、潜在幻觉挖掘和双向函授学习的作用。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows: • RealmForgePipe: A data pipeline for exploring and materializing a model’s own hallucinations. It derives image-editing targets from observed and mined latent hallucinations and constructs visual conditions that make these responses valid. Using this pipeline, we build the Realized Hallucination Dataset ( RealmSet ) from hallucinations mined from Qwen3.5-9B. • RealmMatch: learning to assign hallucinated responses to their supporting images. We propose RealmMatch, which constructs a likelihood score matrix by cross-pairing original and materialized images with candidate responses. Through bidirectional contrastive losses, it suppresses mismatched responses while learning to assign each hallucinated response to its corresponding supporting image. • Empirical validation and ablation analysis. Our experiments and ablation studies demonstrate that hallucination assignment is a promising paradigm for improving visual perception and mitigating hallucinations. DreamRealm improves performance across six visual perception and hallucination benchmarks, with gains of 7.26 percentage points in HallusionBench accuracy and 11.34 percentage points in MMVP pair accuracy on Qwen3.5-9B. We further conduct ablations on data construction and training methods, providing detailed analyses of the contributions of individual components.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下: 探索并实现模型自身幻觉的数据管道。 它从被观测和挖掘出来的潜伏幻觉中产生图像编辑目标,并构筑视觉条件,使这些反应有效。 我们利用这个管道,从Quen3.5-9B钻探出来的幻觉建立了“实现幻觉数据集”。 • RealmMatch:学习如何为其辅助图像指定幻觉反应。 我们提出RealmMatch,它构建一个概率分数矩阵,通过交叉铺设原始和可实现的图像与候选反应. 通过双向对比性损失,它抑制不匹配的响应,同时学会将每个幻觉反应指定给相应的支持图像. · 经验验证和衰竭分析。 我们的实验和抑制研究表明,幻觉任务是改善视觉感知和减轻幻觉的有希望的范例. DreamRealm改善了6个视觉感知和幻觉基准的性能,在Qwen3.5-9B上,Hallausion Bench的精度提高了7.26个百分点,MMVP的双精度提高了11.34个百分点. 我们还对数据构建和培训方法进行了总结,详细分析了各个组成部分的贡献。

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Recent work spans multimodal video understanding and grounding [ 7 , 3 ] , content-safety modeling [ 21 ] , and adversarial evaluation [ 6 , 11 ] , while visual hallucinations remain a central challenge to trustworthy vision-language models.
blocks.zh: 近期的工作涉及多模式视频理解和定位[7,3],内容安全模型[21],以及对抗评价[6,11],而视觉幻觉仍然是值得信赖的视觉语言模型的核心挑战.

blocks.en: 2.1  Hallucination-aware Fine-tuning
blocks.zh: 2.1 幻觉 微调

blocks.en: Hallucination-aware fine-tuning improves the visual faithfulness of multimodal large language models through instruction augmentation, response correction, and preference learning. HALVA [ 27 ] constructs faithful and hallucinated response pairs and applies contrastive supervision to differing phrases to suppress visually unsupported content. RLAIF-V [ 42 ] builds preference data from model feedback and iteratively updates the model. Beyond direct response correction, REVERSE [ 39 ] introduces uncertainty tokens and retrospective resampling to identify and revise potentially hallucinated content. FINER-Tuning [ 40 ] (FINER in our tables) introduces fine-grained contradictions concerning objects, attributes, and relations into otherwise correct descriptions to construct challenging negative queries, and employs DPO to mitigate the resulting hallucinations. These methods construct and leverage error signals in different ways, using contrastive supervision, preference optimization, or self-correction to distinguish visually grounded content from unsupported content. However, these methods primarily correct responses under a fixed image condition, generally giving insufficient consideration to the design of supervision signals on the image-input side.
blocks.zh: 幻觉-知觉微调通过指令增强,响应校正,偏好学习,提高多式联运大语言模型的视觉忠实度. HALVA [27] 构建忠实和幻觉的反应对子,并对不同的短语进行对比性监督,以压制视觉上不支持的内容. RLAIF-V [42] 从模型反馈中构建首选数据,并迭代更新模型. 除了直接反应修正之外,REVERSE[39]引入了不确定符号和追溯性复制,以识别和修订潜在的幻觉内容。 FINER-Tuning[40](我们表格中的FINER)将关于物体、属性和关系的细微矛盾引入了其他正确的描述,以构建挑战性的负面查询,并使用DPO来缓解由此产生的幻觉。 这些方法以不同的方式构建和杠杆错误信号,使用对比性监督,偏好优化,或自我校正来区分视觉上基于的内容和不支持的内容. 然而,这些方法主要在固定的图像条件下纠正反应,一般没有充分考虑图像输入方的监理信号设计.

blocks.en: 2.2  Visual Contrast and Counterfactual Learning
blocks.zh: 2.2 视觉对比和反事实学习

blocks.en: Visual contrasts can be constructed by retrieving or pairing existing real images. These approaches use differences between images to help models distinguish the visual evidence supporting different responses. SymMPO [ 16 ] retrieves similar images using CLIP features and constructs corresponding responses for preference learning across visual conditions. CoCI [ 17 ] uses similar images as contrastive inputs at inference time to adjust response distributions. Such approaches obtain visual contrasts from existing image collections, with the available contrasts depending on the images that can be retrieved or paired.
blocks.zh: 视觉对比可以通过检索或对齐现有的真实图像来构建. 这些方法利用图像之间的差异帮助模型区分支持不同响应的视觉证据. SymMPO [16] 使用CLIP特性检索相似的图像,并构建相应的响应,用于跨视觉条件的偏好学习. CoCI [17] 在推断时间使用类似的图像作为对比性输入来调整响应分布. 这种方法从现有的图像收藏中获得视觉对比,现有对比取决于可以检索或配对的图像.

blocks.en: Another line of work uses image generation and editing to construct visual contrasts with controlled changes. IC-VCO [ 8 ] uses data from SymMPO to construct contrastive images through semantic editing for preference optimization. MED [ 2 ] generates minimal image-editing instructions conditioned on image content within predefined hallucination-prone semantic categories, and uses the resulting image pairs and fine-grained difference descriptions for supervised fine-tuning. These methods use generated visual differences to strengthen the connection between image content and model responses. Visual contrast is also used at inference time: visual contrastive decoding (VCD) [ 13 ] contrasts response distributions under different visual inputs to mitigate hallucinations. However, although these methods provide supervision on the image-input side, their visual contrasts are not specifically designed around the target model’s hallucinations, making it difficult to ensure that supervision targets its actual perceptual confusions.
blocks.zh: 另一行工作使用图像生成和编辑来构建可控变化的视觉对比. IC-VCO [8] 利用SymMPO的数据通过语义编辑构建对比图像,以优化偏好. MED[2]在预定义的幻觉易感语义分类中生成以图像内容为条件的最小图像编辑指令,并使用由此产生的图像配对和细纹差异描述来进行有监督的微调. 这些方法的使用产生了视觉差异,以加强图像内容和模型响应之间的联系. 在推论时间也使用视觉对比:视觉对比解码(VCD)[13]对比不同视觉输入下的反应分布,以缓解幻觉. 然而,虽然这些方法为图像输入方提供了监督,但其视觉对比并不是围绕目标模型的幻觉而专门设计的,因此很难确保监督针对其实际的知觉混淆.

blocks.en: DreamRealm differs from these methods in two key aspects: (1) We explore a model’s diverse latent hallucinated responses and learn to assign them to their supporting visual conditions, going beyond simply correcting erroneous responses under the original image. (2) We derive image-editing targets from the target model’s own hallucinations, ensuring that the resulting visual contrasts directly address its perceptual confusions rather than relying on editing or generation that is not tailored to those confusions.
blocks.zh: DreamRealm在两个关键方面与这些方法不同: (1)我们探索一个模型的各种潜在幻觉反应,并学会将其分配到支持性的视觉条件,超越了简单地纠正原始图像下的错误反应. (2) 我们从目标模型本身的幻觉中得出图像编辑目标,确保由此产生的视觉对比直接解决其概念上的混乱,而不是依赖不适应这些混乱的编辑或生成。

blocks.en: 3  Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: DreamRealm consists of RealmForgePipe, a data pipeline for exploring and materializing a model’s own hallucinations, and RealmMatch, which learns image–response correspondence. Figure 2 illustrates the overall framework. RealmForgePipe comprises two stages: Section 3.1 introduces hallucination exploration, which collects observed hallucinations, mines latent hallucinations, and selects candidate responses through likelihood ranking; Section 3.2 introduces hallucination materialization, which uses minimal image editing and verification to construct visual conditions that make the selected hallucinated responses valid. The pipeline produces the Realized Hallucination Dataset ( RealmSet ), whose composition is described in Section 3.3 . Finally, Section 3.4 presents RealmMatch, which combines supervised learning with bidirectional contrastive learning to assign hallucinated responses to their supporting images while retaining error-correction supervision under the original images.
blocks.zh: DreamRealm由RealmForgePipe和RealmMatch组成,后者是探索和实现模型自身幻觉的数据管道,后者学习图像-应答对应。 图2显示了总体框架。 实战 管道包括两个阶段:第3.1节介绍幻觉探索,收集观察到的幻觉,地雷潜伏的幻觉,并通过概率排名选择候选反应;第3.2节介绍幻觉物质化,使用最小的图像编辑和验证来构建视觉条件,使选定的幻觉反应有效. 输油管生成已实现的幻觉数据集(RealmSet),其组成在第3.3节中作了说明。 最后,第3.4节介绍了RealmMatch,该节结合了有监督的学习和双向对比性学习,以分配对其支持图像的幻觉反应,同时保留原图像下的错更正监督.

blocks.en: 3.1  Exploring the Latent Hallucination World
blocks.zh: 3.1 探索晚期迷幻世界

blocks.en: Let 𝒟 = { ( I i , q i , y i ⋆ ) } i = 1 N \mathcal{D}=\{(I_{i},q_{i},y_{i}^{\star})\}_{i=1}^{N} denote a collection of seed examples, where I i I_{i} is an image, q i q_{i} is a perception question, and y i ⋆ y_{i}^{\star} is the ground-truth answer. For a target MLLM M θ M_{\theta} , our goal is to identify a set ℰ i \mathcal{E}_{i} of incorrect responses that receive high likelihood under the model given ( I i , q i ) (I_{i},q_{i}) . We call these responses latent perceptual hallucinations . Incorrect responses produced under standard decoding are termed observed hallucinations ; latent mining explores additional errors through high-temperature sampling and key-attribute enumeration.

blocks.en: We compare DreamRealm with the corresponding base model to control for backbone differences. On Qwen3.5-9B, DreamRealm improves all seven metrics, mitigating hallucinations while enhancing fine-grained perception. The gains are largest on Qwen3.5-9B, reflecting DreamRealm’s model-specific design: RealmForgePipe constructs supervision from the model’s high-likelihood hallucinations, aligning the training data with its perceptual confusions. As shown in Table , Qwen3.5-9B + DreamRealm obtains the best numerical value in six of the seven reported metrics under our unified evaluation protocol. The only exception is ObjectHal, where its performance remains close to the best result from RLAIF-V. Qualitative comparisons are shown in Figure , with additional examples in Appendix H .

blocks.en: 5  Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: DreamRealm incurs data construction costs, including image generation with GPT-Image and human review, as detailed in Appendices D and D.2 , respectively. In addition, DreamRealm is constrained by the capabilities of the underlying image-editing model, and some scenes remain difficult to edit successfully. Appendix D.1 (Table 2 ) reports the final pass rates of RealmForgePipe across 22 question categories, measured as the proportion of synthesis candidates ultimately approved by human review.
blocks.zh: DreamRealm产生数据构建成本,包括图像生成与GPT-Image和人文评论,分别详见附录D和D.2. 此外,DreamRealm受到基础图像编辑模型能力的制约,一些场景仍然难以成功编辑. 附录D.1(表2)报告了RealmForgePipe在22个问题类别中的最后通过率,衡量标准是综合考生最终经人类审查批准的比例。

blocks.en: 6  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduce DreamRealm, a post-training framework that materializes model hallucination worlds and uses contrastive learning to assign hallucinated responses to their corresponding visual inputs. Consistent improvements across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the potential of this hallucination assignment paradigm to enhance visual perception and mitigate visual hallucinations.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了DreamRealm,一个实现模型幻觉世界的训练后框架,并使用对比学习来分配幻觉对相应视觉投入的反应. 跨越多种基准的不断改进表明,这种幻觉任务模式具有增强视觉感知和减轻视觉幻觉的潜力。

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 provides the complete image-editing workflow described in Section 3.2 , including difficulty tagging, quality verification, question-dependent blind checking, and bounded retry logic. Stages 1.5 and 2.5 record metadata only and never reject samples. Each instruction–type pair permits at most two synthesis attempts in total. After automated checks, human annotators review the candidate before curation; only human-approved records enter the final HG-Edited Data. Human-rejected candidates are excluded.

blocks.en: Minimal editing prioritizes changes necessary to make the target response valid while preserving unrelated scene content and structure. The planner specifies preservation and modification regions R p ​ r ​ e ​ s R_{pres} and R c ​ h ​ g R_{chg} and orders three instructions by increasing expected edit extent. The verifier evaluates minimal editing on a five-point scale, with s m ​ i ​ n ≥ 4 s_{min}\geq 4 required for acceptance, together with s e ​ s ≥ 4 s_{es}\geq 4 and s p ​ l ≥ 3 s_{pl}\geq 3 . This is a planning preference and a verifier-based quality constraint, rather than minimization of a pixel-distance objective or a guarantee of a globally minimal edit. Each instruction can fall back to full-image regeneration, as shown in Algorithm 1 .
blocks.zh: 最小编辑优先排列必要的更改,使目标响应有效,同时保留不相关的场景内容和结构. 规划者指定了保存和修改区域R p r e s R_{pres}和 R c h g R_{chg} 并通过增加预期的编辑范围命令三个指令. 核查员在五分制上评价最小编辑量,接受所需的s m i n 4 s_{min}\geq 4,以及s e s 4 s_{es}\geq 4和s l≥3 s_{pl}\geq 页:1 这是一种规划偏好和基于核查者的质量限制,而不是尽量减少像素-距离的目标或全球最小编辑的保证。 每个指令可以回到全图像再生,如Algorithm 1 所示.

blocks.en: The verifier first answers the original question without access to either supplied answer; counting questions require counting objects individually. It then determines question validity ( A A ), agreement with the ground-truth answer ( B B ), equivalence between the target response and the ground-truth answer ( C C ), refusal ( D D ), and the error type e e . In optional two-pass auditing, both passes must satisfy A A and B B , while either pass triggering C C or D D causes rejection; the stricter audit judgment is retained.
blocks.zh: 核查者首先回答最初的问题,没有获得所提供答案;计数问题需要单独计数对象。 然后确定问题的有效性(A ),同意地面真相答案(B B),目标答复与地面真相答案(C C),拒绝(D D)和错误类型e 之间的等同性。 在可选的双通审计中,两个通行证都必须满足A和B的要求,而触发C或DD的通行证会导致拒绝;更严格的审计判断保留下来。

blocks.en: The algorithm explicitly distinguishes three modes. Strict mode obtains an answer from the edited image with the target response hidden, then judges factual equivalence to y m y_{m} . Relaxed mode extracts a target visual feature from ( R c ​ h ​ g , y m ) (R_{chg},y_{m}) and accepts only a YES response to its presence in the edited image. Skip mode performs no additional check and returns true. Only strict-mode check failures retry the same instruction–type pair; failed synthesis also consumes an attempt and retries, whereas a quality-threshold failure or a relaxed-mode failure advances to the next editing type. All verification scores use a five-point scale.
blocks.zh: 算法明确区分三种模式. 严格模式从编辑的图像中获取一个答案,并隐藏目标响应,然后判断事实等同于y m y _{m}. 放松模式从(R_{chg},y_{m})中提取一个目标视觉特性(R cchg},y_{m}),只接受对它存在于编辑图像中的YES响应. 跳过模式不执行额外的检查并返回真实 。 只有严格模式的检查失败重试相同的指令 - 类型对; 失败的合成也会消耗一次尝试和重试, 而质量阈值的失败或放松模式的失败会推进到下一个编辑类型 。 所有核查分数均采用五分制.

blocks.en: D.2  Human Annotation Review Protocol

blocks.en: Human review is conducted by 12 annotators, all from professional data annotation companies. Before annotation begins, the task and decision criteria are communicated to the annotators. Given an edited image and its proposed response, each annotator judges whether the response is supported by the image. Samples for which this judgment is uncertain are discarded. Each sample is initially reviewed by one annotator, and annotators work on separate, non-overlapping batches.
blocks.zh: 人文审查由12名注释员进行,全部来自专业数据注释公司. 在开始注释之前,任务和决定标准会传达给注释者. 鉴于一个经过编辑的图像及其建议的回应,每个注释者判断该反应是否得到图像的支持. 这一判决不确定的样本被抛弃。 每个样本最初由一个注释员审查,注释员分别进行不重叠的批次工作.

blocks.en: A second quality check is performed on 10% of the data. If an annotator fails this quality check, the data assigned to that annotator are returned and reassigned to a different annotator for reannotation. Only samples accepted through this review process are retained in the final HG-Edited Data.
blocks.zh: 对10%的数据进行了第二次质量检查。 如果注释员未能进行这种质量检查,则将分配给该注释员的数据退回并重新分配给另一个注释员进行重新注释。 只有通过这一审查过程接受的样本才保留在最后的HG编辑数据中。

blocks.en:
We use Qwen3.5-9B as both the hallucination-mining model and the primary training model. We train on original examples and the 27,038 HG-Edited training examples in RealmSet (Section 3.3 ). We partition the data by original-image family, keeping each original image and all its associated edits in the same split. We additionally reserve 5,000 in-distribution examples as a held-out test set, with no original-image family shared with the training data. All showcase examples in the appendix are drawn from this set.
To examine the model specificity of hallucination mining, we also train Qwen2.5-VL-7B [ 1 ] , Gemma-4-E4B-it [ 30 ] , and InternVL3.5-8B [ 36 ] separately on the same data, without additional hallucination mining for these target models.
